card.name: Partway through numbers and names
card.fires_on: The first digit of a number split into pieces, often a year or gun caliber, or the opening piece of a Polish or Hebrew name, in history or military text. Dose numbers also show up.

modes.label: Leading digit of a number
modes.description: A digit that starts or sits inside a multi-digit number such as a date, caliber or dose.

modes.label: Start of a foreign name
modes.description: The piece of a Polish or Hebrew personal name right after a first name or title.

card.plain: It fires on the first digits of numbers, like years and gun sizes, and on the start of unusual names, while the word is still unfinished.
